summary: Buy things from real websites on behalf of your human. Use when you need to purchase a product, complete a checkout, order something online, or propose a purchase for human approval. Handles encrypted credential storage, cryptographic purchase mandates, and headless browser checkout on any merchant site. The agent never sees the card.
